description: This file defines the main Activity for the Lunar Lander game on Android, managing game lifecycle, menu options, and interactions with the LunarView and LunarThread.

classes.name: LunarLander
classes.description: Main activity class managing the Lunar Lander game, including menu setup, activity lifecycle, and interaction with game thread and view.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Sets up the options menu with game controls such as start, stop, pause, resume, and difficulty levels.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections to control game state and difficulty.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the content view, and retrieves references to UI components and game thread.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses the game thread when the activity loses focus.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the current game state for activity restoration.
